subject: Problem with permutation test with scantwo

messages.author: 269e905d87d26565
messages.subject: Problem with permutation test with scantwo
parts:
Dear Karl,

I runned several times a permutation test to obtain the thresholds for a backcross data following your instructions in Rqtl manual. 
I used a sever to make the calculation and split it in different clusters.

Here the code I used : 

#Two dimensional scan and Permutation with data sim 
out14<-scantwo(data.sim,pheno.col = 2,n.cluster = 20,verbose=TRUE,method = "imp")
save(out14, file="scantwo14.RData")
operm14 <- scantwo(data.sim, n.perm=1000,pheno.col = 2,n.cluster = 20)
save(operm14, file="perm14.RData")
summary(operm14)

I had no problems with the 2 QTL scan and I could visualize the data with plots and summarize.scantwo function but 
the problem is that when i tried to see the thresholds so I can only visualize the significant results, I got this each time I tried : 


(the perm14.RData file is never empty --> 43ko)



I didn't get any warning messages but the summary gave me "empty" results 









But when I visualized the data it seems that calculations has been done as I could see for each threshold several values.






Do you know what is happening ? why I don't get any threshold ?

parts: Well I did called the package at the begining of my script and run several command that worked and when I tried to see the results of operm14 it didn't work. But I tried to recall the package again (like you told me) but this time right before using summary(operm14) and indeed it worked ! I don't understand why but thank you !

Le jeudi 26 avril 2018 13:09:38 UTC+2, Karl Broman a écrit :
Maybe R/qtl isn’t loaded? Try 

library(qtl)
summery(operm14)

karl
